name: manage-ai-settings
businessNeed: Let people choose their preferred AI connection independently from task-planning workflows and providers.

workItems.description: Provide an independently discoverable AI settings surface.
workItems.acceptanceCriterion: The settings UI is not imported by AI Planning or Task Management.

workItems.description: Reserve a governed settings feature boundary for persistence.
workItems.acceptanceCriterion: Future settings storage can be added through declared capabilities without changing planning features.
